## Design

### 2026-10-05 — ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/e1457f68662dffb22d88cd3f1e229a2e67d8ac9a2db624b8b2bc84cde25e5d1e.png)

**0.5h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/e1457f68662dffb22d88cd3f1e229a2e67d8ac9a2db624b8b2bc84cde25e5d1e.png)

I looked into different designs made by other people and watched some videos to get more information about the competition. I am thinking of using two motors to drive the board with a trailing wheel. To navigate the track, I want to use some distance sensor (IR or ToF) to accurately read the track. On top of that, I also want to add an encoder to track the rotation of the wheel so there can be feedback to move to a desired position.
